.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/creat.instruction: Run {{script}} <path> [content], where <path> is the slash-separated command path (e.g. create/artifact) and the optional [content] is the full file content to use instead of the default scaffold.

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/list/.instruction: Run {{script}} [search-term] to list every command file under src/src/commands, optionally restricted to those whose content contains search-term, one per line as `[command path]: [file path]`.

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/updat.instruction: Run {{script}} <command-path> <change-request>, where <command-path> is the slash-separated command path (e.g. create/artifact) and <change-request> is ignored by this step.

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/delet.instruction: Run {{script}} <path> where <path> is the slash-separated command path (e.g. create/artifact).
Run {{script}} <path>, where <path> is the command's slash-separated path (e.g. create/artifact) written exactly as it appears in its file location.

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/evalu.instruction: Run {{script}} <path> where <path> is the command's slash-separated path exactly as it appears in its file location (e.g. `create/artifact`), with no quoting needed.

create.text: Scaffolds the command file at src/src/commands/create/artifact.command.ts given a command path and optional content, exiting 1 if it already exists.

list.text: Lists command artifacts in the codebase matching an optional search term, printing each as [command path]: [file path]

update.text: Updates an existing command artifact's source file to satisfy a natural-language change request, given its command path, erroring if the command doesn't exist.

delete.text: Deletes the command artifact with the given command path, removing its file and cleaning up dangling references to it across the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks that a command artifact's file structure, Progress usage, and input handling comply with the artifact rules, given its command path, printing pass or itemized rule violations.
